title: AttributeError on guest checkout session dereferencing NoneType user
error_log:
FAILED tests/test_payment.py::test_charge_card
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "app/services/checkout.py", line 84, in process_cart
    user_id = cart.user.customer_id
AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'customer_id'
ground_truth_root_cause: Unchecked cart.user attribute dereference on anonymous cart session
ground_truth_patch:
--- a/app/services/checkout.py
+++ b/app/services/checkout.py
@@ -82,3 +82,5 @@ def process_cart(cart):
-    user_id = cart.user.customer_id
+    if not cart or not cart.user:
+        raise ValueError("Invalid checkout session: cart user cannot be None")
+    user_id = cart.user.customer_id
